title: Training Questions: How the Cure of a Cancellation Shapes the Restoration Core Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
These questions train representatives on the restoration core charge for a reinstatement filing on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate. The restoration core charge follows how the certified policy's cancellation was cured.

**Q1. What are "cure days"?**
The calendar days from the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's cancellation effective date to the posting date of the latest reinstatement fee on the Cardinal Billing Account ledger.

**Q2. Against what are cure days compared?**
Against the billing plan's reinstatement-without-lapse days — the number of calendar days after the cancellation effective date within which, under the household's Cardinal Billing Account pay plan, a reinstatement payment restores coverage with no lapse. "No more than" includes equality.

**Q3. What does the core charge come to?**

| Cure days against the plan's reinstatement-without-lapse days | Billing account enrolled in automatic payment? | Restoration core charge |
|---|---|---|
| No more than | Yes | Half the adjusted restoration rate, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| No more than | No | Three quarters of the adjusted restoration rate, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| More than | Either | The adjusted restoration rate as it stands |
| No cancellation effective date, or no reinstatement fee, on record | Either | The adjusted restoration rate as it stands |

**Q4. Which automatic-payment setting counts?**
Whether the Cardinal Billing Account is enrolled in automatic payment, as the account shows it.

**Q5. Can you show the rounding? (hypothetical figures)**
Take an adjusted restoration rate of 13.50.
- Half is 6.75; rounded down to the whole dollar: **6.00**.
- Three quarters is 10.125; rounded up to the whole dollar: **11.00**.
- As it stands: **13.50**.

**Q6. Where is the boundary? (hypothetical plan of 3 reinstatement-without-lapse days)**
Cancellation effective 1 April. Reinstatement fee posted 4 April: 3 cure days, no more than 3, so the first or second row applies. Posted 5 April: 4 cure days, more than 3, so the core charge is the adjusted restoration rate as it stands.

**Q7. Two reinstatement fees are on the ledger. Which posting date is used?**
The latest one.
